We're creative problem solvers who help visionaries smash through boundaries and think beyond what's possible so they can think about what's next. But we're not just built for the tech savvy. We democratize the latest payments technology so that everyone can realize the benefits of easy payments across the full spectrum of commerce. Our mission is to use our expertise to enable more payments, in more ways and more places. We provide ISOs, Fintech Innovators and Technologists the freedom to focus on what they do best, liberating them from restricted payment solutions and giving them access to the latest payment technology now and in the future.</p> <h3>How We Work - Our Core Values</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Be a Good Person, It's Simple.</strong> We treat everyone fairly and with respect. We lead with kindness, humility and integrity. We take the time to understand each other and our customers. And we serve with care, because customers are never a transaction, and always our focus</li> <li><strong>Align, Trust & Go.</strong> We debate openly, listen carefully and challenge thoughtfully. Once we decide, we move forward together - holding ourselves accountable to our commitments, and focusing on what matters most to our customers. That alignment creates momentum.</li> <li><strong>Raise the Bar.</strong> Good enough isn't enough. We stay curious, measure everything, stay honest about progress and keep pushing ourselves to think creatively. We drive change, again and again. And leave things better than we found them. When we raise the bar, our customers feel it too.</li> </ul> <h3>Key Responsibilities:</h3> <p><strong>Customer Qualification & Solution Scoping</strong></p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with Account Executives and Channel Account Managers to assess and qualify customer requirements.</li> <li>Recommend tailored solutions, identify opportunities for product extensions, and evaluate the feasibility of customer-specific requests that require development work.</li> <li>Identify challenges early and propose viable technical solutions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Solution Documentation & Onboarding Support</strong></p> <ul> <li>Document customer use cases, solution designs, and onboarding plans so that teams share a clear picture of what has been agreed.</li> <li>Ensure alignment across Sales, Partner Launch Managers, and Account Managers for a seamless handover.</li> <li>Identify and plan customer training needs.</li> <li>Respond to technical questions on NMI's platform, and deliver architectural diagrams, system workflows, and configuration recommendations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Demonstrations & Training</strong></p> <ul> <li>Provide tailored demonstrations of the NMI platform for ISVs, ISOs, and other partner types.</li> <li>Develop and deliver bespoke training content aligned with customer needs.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-functional Collaboration</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support Sales in responding to RFPs, coordinating with Product, Engineering, and Security as needed.</li> <li>Raise and track product enhancement requests on behalf of customers.</li> <li>Relay common feedback, feature gaps, and usability insights to the Product team.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Sales Enablement & Continuous Improvement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Stay current on product updates, release notes, and roadmap discussions.</li> <li>Maintain close contact with acquiring partners and support their technical enablement.</li> <li>Represent NMI at industry events and network with partners and prospects.</li> </ul> <h3>Essential Skills and Experience:</h3> <ul> <li>3–5 years' experience in Solutions/Sales Engineering, Solutions Consulting, or Technical Account Management, ideally in FinTech or SaaS.</li> <li>Strong understanding of payment processing, including card-present, card-not-present, tokenization, gateways, and acquiring.</li> <li>Experience with unattended payment environments such as Parking, Transit, EV Charging, Vending, and similar kiosk/self-service channels, including familiarity with unattended-specific integration, hardware/device, and compliance considerations.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience producing solution design documents or technical scoping materials.</li> <li>Proven ability to work cross-functionally across technical and non-technical teams.</li> <li>Exceptional communication and documentation skills.</li> <li>Comfortable presenting and demonstrating solutions to varied audiences.</li> </ul> <p>Do you feel like you have a slightly out of the ordinary career path or history? We are open to all walks of life and very willing to hear your story. Please don't feel like this should be a barrier to securing a great career at NMI! We appreciate success can come in all shapes and sizes. Fill in the 'Additional Info' box on our application to tell us more about your path.</p> <h3>As well as being a part of something exciting everyday, you will also receive the following benefits:</h3> <ul> <li>Annual bonus scheme dependent on individual and company performance</li> <li>Annual salary of £45,000—£60,000</li> <li>25 days holiday each year (+ bank holidays + 1 day after each year of service with up to a max. of 30 days)</li> <li>Workplace pension scheme</li> <li>Private medical insurance (upon 30 days of employment)</li> <li>7 hours per day, 35 hours per week</li> <li>A remote first culture</li> <li>Great work-life balance with our Flexi-time policy</li> <li>Family Friendly policies (Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Pay and Shared Parental Leave).</li> <li>A chance to develop with an allocated company training budget</li> <li>Bike2Work Scheme</li> <li>Lifeworks, an Employee Assistance Programme which offers wellbeing, family and financial support services, such as assessments, resources and even 1:1 counselling sessions. It also offers interesting perks such as discounts on gyms, restaurants, high street retailers and cinema tickets</li> <li>A strong commitment to employee wellbeing including mental health first aiders</li> <li>Employee referral scheme with generous financial reward</li> <li>Bonusly colleague reward scheme</li> </ul> <p>We believe that having a diverse group of employees strengthens both our work and our workplace. title: Engineering Leader
description: About Ema Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs. We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale. The Role We are looking for an Engineering Leader to manage and scale multiple product lines in the Voice, BPO, and Workforce Management space. This is a high-impact leadership role that sits at the intersection of real-time voice systems, operations research, and data-intensive platform engineering. You will report directly to the Head of Engineering and own the engineering organization that builds the infrastructure powering Ema’s Voice AI Employees, Agent QA, auto-learning pipelines, rich analytics, and workforce optimization capabilities — all operating as scalable, multi-tenant systems deployed across global geographies. You will collaborate with Product, ML/AI, and Go-to-Market teams to translate customer needs into production systems that handle high volumes of voice data, deliver real-time insights, and continuously improve through automated learning loops. As the owner of multiple product lines, you will balance roadmap priorities across Voice, BPO operations, and WFM (work force management) — ensuring each product evolves cohesively while meeting distinct customer needs. What You Will Do Scalable Multi-Tenant Systems Architect and build multi-tenant systems that serve enterprise customers across geographies with strict data residency, isolation, and compliance requirements. Design high-throughput ingestion systems capable of processing large volumes of voice data, call metadata, and operational telemetry in near real-time. Make foundational architectural decisions on data stores, stream processing, and storage tiers — balancing query performance, cost, and operational simplicity. Champion SOLID principles, clean architecture, and engineering rigor across all codebases — ensuring systems are testable, extensible, and maintainable at scale. Team Building & Engineering Culture Recruit, hire, and develop senior engineers across a multi-disciplinary function spanning voice engineering, backend systems, data engineering, and applied operations research. Establish engineering standards, code review culture, and a strong bias toward shipping — with equal commitment to system reliability and customer experience. Coach and grow senior/staff engineers into technical leaders; manage engineering managers as the organization scales. Drive cross-functional alignment with Product, ML/AI, and Go-to-Market teams to ensure the platform evolves in lockstep with customer needs and market feedback. Voice Platform & Agent QA Own the end-to-end engineering for Ema’s AgentQA capabilities — real-time voice pipelines, telephony integrations, and voice-to-action workflows. Build and scale the Agent QA platform: automated call scoring, compliance monitoring, sentiment analysis, and coaching feedback loops. Design auto-learning systems that continuously improve voice agents from production interactions — closed-loop feedback, model retraining triggers, and quality regression detection. Deliver rich voice analytics: call volume trends, handle time distributions, first-call resolution metrics, agent performance dashboards, and anomaly detection. Build scalable voice pipeline across geographies – keeping in mind PII, security and compliance requirements. Workforce Management & Operations Research Build WFM capabilities including demand forecasting, shift scheduling, real-time adherence monitoring, and capacity planning — applying operations research techniques to optimize workforce utilization. Design and implement optimization algorithms for headcount modeling, skill-based routing, and workload balancing across multi-site, multi-timezone contact center operations. Partner with ML/AI teams to integrate predictive models for call volume forecasting, attrition risk, and staffing efficiency. What We Look For Required 12+ years of software engineering experience, with 4+ years leading engineering teams of 8+ engineers at high-growth startups or top-tier tech companies. Deep expertise in building real-time, data-intensive systems. Strong foundation in data stores and storage systems: relational databases, time-series stores, columnar analytics engines, and caching layers — with the judgment to choose the right tool for the workload. Experience building quality software using AI-driven tools and workflows. Track record of taking products from 0→1 and iterating rapidly based on customer feedback. Hands-on proficiency with SOLID principles, clean architecture, and design patterns — you write and review production code and lead by example on system design. Experience building scalable multi-tenant SaaS platforms with data isolation, geo-distributed deployments, and compliance requirements (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA). Track record of building ingestion systems for high volumes of load — event-driven architectures, stream processing (Kafka, Flink, or equivalent), and batch/real-time hybrid pipelines. Strong product sense: ability to deeply understand customer problems in contact center, voice, and workforce domains and translate them into clean technical solutions. Proven ability to hire, develop, and retain high-caliber engineers across multiple disciplines in competitive markets. Good to have Experience in voice/telephony systems: WebRTC, SIP, voice-over-IP infrastructure, or contact center platforms. Background in operations research or optimization: scheduling algorithms, linear/integer programming, constraint satisfaction, or demand forecasting models. Experience building analytics platforms: OLAP systems, real-time dashboards, metric computation engines, or BI infrastructure. Prior work on auto-learning or continuous improvement systems: feedback loops from production data, automated retraining pipelines, or quality monitoring systems. Experience with AI/ML-powered products in enterprise settings — agentic automation, LLM orchestration, or AI-driven UX. Familiarity with WFM or contact center operations — staffing models, Erlang-based capacity planning, or real-time adherence systems. Why Ema Build at the intersection of Voice AI, operations research, and enterprise-scale systems — a rare combination of deeply technical challenges with direct customer impact. Shape the engineering foundation of a category-defining AI platform — your architectural decisions will power how the world’s largest enterprises run their voice and workforce operations. High-impact, high-visibility role with direct access to the Head of Engineering, co-founders, and enterprise customers. A team of exceptional engineers from Google, Meta, Microsoft Research, and top CS programs worldwide. Competitive compensation, meaningful equity, and the opportunity to build something that matters. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. title: Fraud Investigator (Crypto)
description: 💰 £25k-£60k, depending on experience and location 📍 UK / Europe / Remote Fanvue is one of the fastest-growing creator monetisation platforms globally. We're an AI-powered, creator-first platform helping creators connect, engage, and earn directly from their audiences at scale. Fanvue has surpassed $200m+ in annual recurring revenue, with triple-digit year-on-year growth, supporting hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans worldwide. As crypto usage on Fanvue's payment rails keeps growing, so does our exposure to crypto-specific fraud and financial crime. Recent cases have shown gaps in the Fraud team's crypto knowledge, and right now nobody on the team has dedicated crypto fraud or financial crime expertise. This role exists to build that capability from the ground up. 🎯 The Role We're hiring Fanvue's first Fraud Investigator with dedicated crypto expertise, reporting to Head of Fraud. AI has taken our fraud detection as far as it can on crypto rails, what's missing is in-house subject matter expertise: someone who has used these investigation tools before, can set the strategy, and can train the rest of the team. 🚀 What You'll Do Lead on investigating cases of potential fraud or financial crime where crypto rails are involved, including payment fraud, account takeover, and money laundering typologies on crypto on/off-ramps Build out crypto-specific fraud investigation capability within the Fraud team: on-chain tracing methods, tooling, and documented process for crypto-related cases Train the wider Fraud team on crypto fraud red flags and typologies, so risk indicators get caught earlier in standard triage, not just by you Design how Fanvue prevents and detects crypto-related fraud and financial crime as the function matures Work directly with vendors to get the most out of crypto investigation tooling and data Support fraud and financial crime investigations where crypto isn't involved, as part of the wider Fraud team's caseload Lead on escalations to law enforcement where relevant Feed your expertise into loss prevention strategy across Fraud, product, and payments 👀 Who You Are 3+ years investigating fraud and/or financial crime with specific crypto/blockchain exposure, from an exchange, blockchain analytics firm, bank crypto desk, or law enforcement crypto unit A process creator and improver: you've played a role in designing or improving investigation techniques, not just following them Comfortable being the subject matter expert. As our first crypto-focused Fraud hire, you'll build the wider team's knowledge while acting as the go-to for other parts of the business (payments, payouts, product) wherever crypto risk shows up Familiar with crypto investigation tooling (e.g. Chainalysis, TRM Labs, Elliptic, etc.) and know how to get the most from it in a fraud prevention context High ownership: excited by a large, expanding remit, and not afraid to break new ground without an existing playbook ✨ You'll Thrive Here If You want to build a function from scratch rather than inherit one You're energised by being the go-to expert and enjoy teaching others what you know You like combining hands-on casework with process and systems design You're comfortable working across functions, Fraud, product, payments, to get crypto risk taken seriously ⚠️ You'll Struggle Here If You need an established playbook, team, or tooling already in place before you can be effective You'd rather stay purely hands-on and not upskill others You're not comfortable being the sole specialist accountable for a new risk area 🌍 Why Join Fanvue? Sunday Times Best Places to Work, two years running. We don't just say we have great culture, we prove it A genuine greenfield opportunity: build Fanvue's first in-house crypto fraud capability from scratch Direct exposure across Fraud, Payments, and Product as crypto usage grows AI-native: we are not bolting AI on, it's core to our product and how we work Remote-friendly across UK/Europe High annual leave flexibility Support with upskilling and development costs Benefits package including gym memberships, apps, and more we're actively building out ⭐ Fanvue is for Everyone We know that diverse teams build better products. Even if you do not meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Potential, mindset, and ambition matter just as much as experience. title: Integrated Marketing Lead
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰£78,000 - £128,000 +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits"> Benefits</a> | 12 month fixed term contract</p> <p>The Integrated Marketing Lead will lead our marketing efforts across all channels, driving the marketing strategy and delivering campaigns that align with Monzo’s business objectives. You will also manage teams to deliver these campaigns where relevant.<br><br>This is a 12 month fixed term contract.</p> <p><strong>Capabilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Cross-Functional Leadership: Ability to effectively align and guide Marketing centres of excellence (across channels, content and other areas) to drive campaigns for your Collective that are cohesive and impactful</li> <li>Strategic Thinking & Vision: Capacity to develop a comprehensive and scalable marketing strategy that drives outcomes for the Wealth business while balancing the overall capacity of Marketing CoEs.</li> <li>Commercial Acumen in Marketing: Strong understanding of budget management and resource allocation, with knowledge of which campaigns deliver value for your Collective</li> <li>Integrated Campaign Design: Expertise in crafting and executing integrated marketing campaigns that connect messaging, creative assets, and channels to create a unified and compelling product narrative.</li> <li>Data-Driven Optimisation: Proficiency in using data and analytics to evaluate marketing performance, identify opportunities for optimization (in line with Commercial acumen above), and refine strategies/portfolios of campaigns</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll be doing: </strong><br><br>Set, develop and execute the integrated marketing strategy for the Collective, both semi-annually and on on-going basis (as needed). This needs to align with Collective’s business goals, customer needs and Marketing capacity</p> <ul> <li>Ensure the portfolio of campaigns is delivered for your Collective, collaborating with teams in Marketing (in particular PMM), product and growth. You need to drive consistency, transparency and alignment of these campaigns across these groups</li> <li>Manage any Collective-specific budget (where it exists), and the capacity for the Collective’s campaigns within owned channels. Work closely with finance and relevant teams to ensure capacity allocation aligns with business priorities</li> <li>Monitor and report on Collective’s performance, tracking key metrics and regularly providing updates to senior leadership</li> <li>Lead the optimisation of your Collective’s marketing campaigns, acting as either thought partner or operator/executor depending on importance.</li> <li>Support stakeholder communication by preparing presentations, strategic updates, and reports, ensuring leadership stays informed of key Collective outcomes</li> </ul> <p><strong>You’ll love this role if you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead marketing initiatives within a tech or regulated financial services environment.</li> <li>Are passionate about building and leading inclusive, high-performing teams.</li> <li>Own outcomes and drive work for a business or part of a business</li> <li>Have a track record of managing several Marketing campaigns</li> <li>Influence senior stakeholders and align marketing strategies with business objectives</li> <li>Own and report on performance metrics for business areas overall</li> <li>Have strong analytical skills and are comfortable with tools like spreadsheets and Looker</li> <li>Are experienced in managing both cash budgets and channel capacity in a marketing context</li> <li>Are organised, detail-oriented, and an excellent project manager.</li> <li>Communicate effectively and clearly</li> </ul> <p><strong>A bit about you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>​ You think strategically, but you’re not afraid to get hands-on.</li> <li>​ You understand how to prioritise when there’s a lot to juggle</li> <li>​ You bring people together and know how to get them excited about the work.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>​ You care about doing the right thing for customers and for the business.</li> <li>​ You’re humble and curious, asking for help when you need it and you’re always looking for ways to do things better.</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Interview Process</strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves three main stages:</p> <ul> <li>Initial Call (30mins) </li> <li>Case Study Presentation (45mins)</li> <li>x2 final interviews via Google Meet (45mins for each interview)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here.</a></p> <p>You’ll hear from us throughout the application process, but if you’ve got any questions, please reach out to hiring@monzo.com. You can also use this email address to let us know if there’s anything we can do to make the process easier for you because of disability, neurodiversity or anything else.</p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>£98,000 - £128,000 as a base salary</li> <li>This role will be based out of our London office next to Liverpool Street station in a hybrid approach of office based and home working, or remotely within the UK </li> <li>We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</li> <li>Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences </li> <li>And much more, see our full list of benefits<a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits"> <strong>here </strong></a></li> </ul> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. <br><br>#LI-JB1 #LI-REMOTE</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Ingénieur Terrain / Field Engineer F/H/X

Nos clients évoluent dans tous les secteurs, que ce soit dans le domaine public ou privé, notamment dans l'aéroportuaire, l'éducation et les gouvernements. Chez Genetec, nous favorisons la communication, la créativité et l'apprentissage continu, offrant ainsi à chacun l'opportunité de s'épanouir dans son propre parcours professionnel. Notre entreprise, composée de plus de 2400 personnes, est constituée d'individus diversifiés, passionnés par leur travail et ouverts à l'exploration de nouvelles idées. Nous accordons la priorité à la réussite et au bien-être de nos employés, comme en témoignent les résultats de notre enquête interne sur l'engagement, avec une note de 4,4/5. Découvrez l'environnement de travail et la culture de Genetec dans cette vidéo ! 💡 Les missions Nous recherchons actuellement un Ingénieur Terrain qui assurera des prestations professionnelles à distance et sur site auprès des clients Genetec. Ses missions incluront le support technique à distance et sur site, le déploiement et la mise en service des systèmes, les audits et évaluations d’installations, tout en agissant comme interlocuteur technique privilégié entre Genetec et ses clients. Développer des relations de confiance durables avec nos clients et les accompagner dans la réussite de leurs projets. Devenir un véritable expert des solutions Genetec et contribuer activement à leur adoption et à leur optimisation. Assurer un suivi rigoureux des incidents et interventions au sein de nos outils de gestion et de notre CRM. Coordonner l’escalade des situations critiques et mobiliser les bonnes ressources pour garantir la satisfaction client. Apporter des solutions efficaces et assurer une résolution rapide des problématiques rencontrées. Accompagner les clients en les conseillant sur les meilleures pratiques, les évolutions technologiques, les montées de version et les projets d’intégration ou d’optimisation de leurs systèmes. Produire les rapports et recommandations nécessaires pour offrir une visibilité claire sur l’état et les performances des environnements déployés. 🌟 A propos de vous : *Nous vous invitons à postuler même si vous ne remplissez pas tous les critères. Nous proposons un accompagnement pour vous aider à atteindre votre plein potentiel dans ce rôle.* Diplôme en informatique, en génie électrique ou expérience équivalente. Expérience en relation client, support technique et/ou gestion de projets. Excellente maîtrise de l’administration et du dépannage des environnements Windows (Active Directory, partage de fichiers, IIS, clustering, GPO, supervision des performances, etc.). Solides connaissances des principes de réseaux informatiques et des protocoles IP. Bonne compréhension des solutions de stockage réseau (SAN, NAS, iSCSI), des bonnes pratiques associées ainsi que des concepts de virtualisation des serveurs. Attitude proactive et orientée solutions, avec la capacité à gérer plusieurs sujets simultanément et à prioriser efficacement. Excellentes capacités d’analyse et forte volonté d’apprendre en continu afin d’évoluer au rythme des technologies et des logiciels. Esprit d’équipe tout en étant autonome dans la gestion de sa charge de travail. Excellentes compétences en communication, avec une maîtrise professionnelle du français et de l’anglais. Contrôle d’accès (lecteurs, contrôleurs, câblage, etc.). Systèmes et technologies de reconnaissance des plaques d’immatriculation (LPR/ALPR). title: Sales Manager - Tech & Data (all genders)
description: Dein Platz in der MAI Group Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu, knüpfst gerne neue Kontakte und hast richtig Lust auf Vertrieb? Du bist sales-driven, liebst den persönlichen Austausch und möchtest Kund:innen für digitale und technologische Lösungen begeistern? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams als Sales Manager (all genders) in der Business Unit Technology & Data. Unser Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Entwicklung und Umsetzung digitaler, technologischer und datengetriebener Lösungen. Dabei unterstützen wir Unternehmen unter anderem bei ihrer digitalen Transformation, der Weiterentwicklung ihrer Geschäftsmodelle und der Optimierung ihrer Prozesse. Für unser weiteres Wachstum suchen wir eine extrovertierte und kommunikationsstarke Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägtem Vertriebsfokus. Du bist gerne auf Messen, Konferenzen und Veranstaltungen unterwegs, gehst proaktiv auf Kund:innen zu und fühlst dich ebenso wohl im persönlichen Gespräch wie am Telefon oder im Videocall. MAI ist eine starke Gruppe mit acht Agenturen verteilt auf die Standorte Hamburg, Berlin, Paderborn, Köln, Augsburg, München, Wien – verbunden durch gemeinsame Ziele, gegenseitigen Austausch und die Zusammenarbeit über Standortgrenzen hinweg. Wo Du auch bei uns startest: Du wirst Teil Deines Teams vor Ort und gleichzeitig Teil von MAI. Was Du bei uns bewegst Du gewinnst aktiv neue Kund:innen, entwickelst nachhaltige Geschäftsbeziehungen und erkennst Cross- und Upselling-Potenziale. Du identifizierst relevante Unternehmen, Ansprechpartner:innen und konkrete Vertriebschancen und entwickelst diese zu konkreten Verkaufschancen weiter. Du gehst proaktiv auf potenzielle Kund:innen zu – auf Messen, Konferenzen, Veranstaltungen, in persönlichen Terminen, am Telefon und in Videocalls. Du führst Erst- und Bedarfsgespräche, verstehst die strategischen Herausforderungen unserer Kund:innen und arbeitest den konkreten geschäftlichen Nutzen unserer Leistungen heraus. Du agierst beratend und lösungsorientiert, entwickelst bereits in frühen Phasen passende Lösungsansätze und kannst auf Kundenanforderungen flexibel reagieren sowie ad hoc geeignete Lösungsideen aus unserem breiten Portfolio ableiten. Du präsentierst unser Leistungsportfolio überzeugend und vermittelst komplexe technologische Themen verständlich und nutzenorientiert. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Expert:innen aus Technologie, Data, Beratung und Delivery zusammen, bindest sie gezielt in den Vertriebsprozess ein und koordinierst die Entwicklung individueller Lösungen. Du begleitest Kund:innen vom Erstkontakt bis zum Vertragsabschluss, führst Verhandlungen, erstellst beziehungsweise koordinierst Angebote und wirkst an Pitches und Ausschreibungen mit. Du pflegst deine Kontakte, Aktivitäten und Opportunities im CRM, entwickelst den Sales Funnel konsequent weiter und beobachtest Märkte, Unternehmen und Mitbewerber, um daraus neue Vertriebsansätze abzuleiten. Du repräsentierst die Business Unit Technology & Data sowie die MAI Group auf relevanten Messen, Konferenzen und Events und arbeitest eng mit dem Director Strategie & Sales sowie den Account Manager:innen zusammen und unterstützt bei ausgewählten Marketing- und Vertriebsinitiativen. Was Dich ausmacht Du verfügst über 3–5 Jahre konkrete Erfahrung im B2B-Sales, idealerweise im Umfeld von IT, Technologie, Digitalisierung, Data, Beratung oder vergleichbaren Dienstleistungen. Du hast große Freude am Verkaufen, möchtest aktiv Kund:innen gewinnen sowie Abschlüsse erzielen, bist sales-driven, zielorientiert und verfolgst deine Vertriebsziele konsequent. Du bist extrovertiert, kontaktfreudig und gehst selbstbewusst sowie authentisch auf neue Menschen zu. Du bist ein:e überzeugende:r Netzwerker:in und bewegst dich gerne auf Messen, Konferenzen, Veranstaltungen und in relevanten Business-Netzwerken. Falls du schon Erfahrung in Kalt-Akquise gemacht hast, ist das von Vorteil, da du dann schon gezeigt hast, dass du für Sales brennst. Du kommunizierst sicher und überzeugend – persönlich, am Telefon, per Videocall und schriftlich und hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Menschen, Situationen und geschäftliche Potenziale. Du verstehst strategische Kundenanforderungen, kannst den konkreten Kundennutzen unserer Leistungen herausarbeiten, denkst beratend und lösungsorientiert und verkaufst nicht einfach Einzelleistungen, sondern passende Lösungen für die Herausforderungen unserer Kund:innen. Du kannst dich schnell in neue Themen und unser Leistungsportfolio einarbeiten, bereits in frühen Gesprächsphasen erste Lösungsansätze formulieren, passende Lösungsideen ableiten und die richtigen Expert:innen einbinden. Du verfügst über ein breites Verständnis für Technologie, Data, Digitalisierung und IT oder hast eine starke Motivation, dir dieses Wissen anzueignen. Du musst kein:e technische:r Spezialist:in sein, bringst aber das Interesse und Selbstvertrauen mit, unsere Leistungen überzeugend zu verkaufen. Du kannst komplexe Leistungen verständlich erklären und ihren strategischen sowie wirtschaftlichen Mehrwert vermitteln. Du arbeitest eigenständig, verbindlich, strukturiert und mit hoher Umsetzungsstärke, bist hartnäckig im positiven Sinne und bleibst auch bei längeren Sales Cycles am Ball. Du hast Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, idealerweise Hubspot, entwickelst deine Vertriebsaktivitäten datenbasiert weiter und der sichere Umgang mit PowerPoint und Excel ist für dich selbstverständlich. Du beherrschst Deutsch auf sehr hohem Niveau und kannst dich auch auf Englisch sicher im beruflichen Kontext verständigen. Was wir Dir bieten Eine verantwortungsvolle Sales-Position mit klarem Fokus auf Neukundengewinnung, Geschäftsentwicklung und nachhaltigem Wachstum Die Möglichkeit, den Vertrieb in der Business Unit Technology & Data aktiv mitzugestalten Ein spannendes Leistungsportfolio an der Schnittstelle von Technology, Data, Digitalisierung, E-Commerce, Marketing und Vertrieb Das erwartet Dich: Hybrides Arbeiten an unseren MAI Standorten mit vielen weiteren kreativen Menschen Angenehme Kund: innen, die ihren Dienstleistern auf Augenhöhe begegnen Flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten und Workation Quartalsmeetings, Workshops, Abendessen oder auch mal Partys. Wir sorgen dafür, dass das breit aufgestellte Team regelmäßig zusammenkommt und wir uns eine gute Zeit machen Freie Gerätewahl (Mac / Windows / Linux – auch privat nutzbar) JobRad, WorkLifePortal und Corporate Benefits 20 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge Heiligabend & Silvester frei Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰£68,000 - £88,000 +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits"> Benefits</a> | 12 month fixed term contract</p> <p>We're looking for an Integrated Marketing Manager to play a big role in bringing our marketing campaigns to life for one of our key teams - what we call a Collective (Borrowing, Wealth, Growth, Core Banking, Payments, or Business Banking).</p> <p>You’ll report into the Lead for your area and work closely with lots of different teams across Monzo to make sure our marketing is joined-up, effective, and delivers real results.</p> <p>This is a hands-on role where you'll be leading the charge on campaign planning and performance, working with a smart, supportive group of marketers, product managers, analysts, and creatives.<br><br>This is a 12 month fixed term contract.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>​Owning and delivering the integrated marketing strategy for your Collective - both long-term and in response to new opportunities as they come up.</li> <li>​Bringing together the right people across Marketing especially Product Marketing, Product, and Growth to make sure every campaign is clear, connected, and on track.</li> <li>​Managing budgets and capacity for your area - making sure we’re focusing on what matters most and that’s where we’re investing.</li> <li>​Keeping a close eye on how things are going - tracking campaign performance, spotting trends, and sharing updates with senior leadership.</li> <li>​Optimising our campaigns over time - sometimes as a strategic thought partner, sometimes by rolling up your sleeves and getting stuck in.</li> <li>​Supporting visibility of stakeholders with updates and insights that keep everyone informed and aligned.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You’ll love this role if you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Are a natural at driving projects, and love getting campaigns you’re proud of over the line with cross-functional teams.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>​Are comfortable working across lots of different marketing channels and understand how to bring them together in a way that makes sense to customers.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>​Have a solid understanding of campaign performance metrics and know how and when to act on them.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>​Have experience working in marketing within a regulated or fast-moving tech environment.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>​Are confident using data and analytics to spot opportunities, improve performance, and tell a clear story.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>​Are a great communicator who can tailor your message to your audience — whether that’s senior leadership or the people you’re collaborating with every day.</li> </ul> <p><strong>A bit about you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>​You think strategically, but you’re not afraid to get hands-on.</li> <li>​You understand how to prioritise when there’s a lot to juggle</li> <li>​You bring people together and know how to get them excited about the work.</li> <li>You care about doing the right thing for customers and for the business.</li> <li>You’re humble and curious, asking for help when you need it and you’re always looking for ways to do things better.</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Interview Process</strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves three main stages:</p> <ul> <li>Initial Call (30mins) </li> <li>Case Study Presentation (45mins)</li> <li>x2 final interviews via Google Meet (45mins for each interview)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here.</a></p> <p>You’ll hear from us throughout the application process, but if you’ve got any questions, please reach out to hiring@monzo.com. You can also use this email address to let us know if there’s anything we can do to make the process easier for you because of disability, neurodiversity or anything else.</p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>£68,000 - £88,000 as a base salary</li> <li>This role will be based out of our London office next to Liverpool Street station in a hybrid approach of office based and home working, or remotely within the UK </li> <li>We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</li> <li>Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences </li> <li>And much more, see our full list of benefits<a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits"> <strong>here </strong></a></li> </ul> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. <br><br>#LI-JB1 #LI-REMOTE</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Offpage SEO & Publisher Manager (m/w/d)
description: Über GetMentioned GetMentioned.com ist die SEO-Plattform für Sichtbarkeit in Google und KI-Suchen. Agenturen, Inhouse-SEOs und Marketing-Teams erreichen mit uns Top-Rankings für ihre wichtigsten Suchbegriffe und werden in ChatGPT, Perplexity & Co. genannt. Dafür kombinieren wir unsere eigene Content Engine TextRocket mit einem Online-PR-Marktplatz mit über 100.000 Publishern. Deine Mission Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden schnell, sauber und profitabel die Offpage-Ergebnisse bekommen, für die sie uns bezahlen: präzise Buchungen, stabile Publisher-Beziehungen und messbare SEO-Effekte. Wichtiger Hinweis zur Rolle Mindestens 70–80 % deiner Zeit sind konzentrierte Abarbeitung: volle Inbox runterarbeiten (Kunden- & Publisher-Mails) Buchungen korrekt durchziehen Pläne bauen, nachhalten, kontrollieren Wenn du Freude an strukturierter, teils monotoner Arbeit mit hohem Durchsatz hast, wirst du diese Rolle lieben. Wenn du nur brainstormen willst ist das hier nichts für dich. Deine Aufgaben Buchungen und Kampagnenaufträge unserer Kunden im System aufnehmen, prüfen und sauber abwickeln Passende Publisher für Kundenprojekte auswählen, anfragen und Konditionen innerhalb der Vorgaben klären Full‑Service‑Offpage‑Pläne für Kunden ausarbeiten (Linkpakete, Platzierungspläne, Timings) Laufende Kommunikation mit Kunden und Publishern (E‑Mail, Plattform, Calls) Lektorat von SEO Texten auf Deutsch & Englisch Qualität der Placements sichern: Themen‑Fit, KPIs, Verlinkung, Prüfung, Reporting Bestehende Publisher-Beziehungen pflegen und neue relevante Quellen identifizieren Datenpflege & Auswertungen in unseren Tools (z. B. Eigene Plattform, CRM, SEO‑Tools) Prozesse mitdenken: Engpässe erkennen, Verbesserungsvorschläge machen und mit uns umsetzen Was du mitbringst 1–2+ Jahre Erfahrung in Offpage‑SEO / Linkbuilding / Digital PR oder Publisher‑Management Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort UND Schrift Gutes Englisch; Französisch ist ein Plus Erfahrung mit mind. einem SEO‑Tool (z. B. Ahrefs, Sistrix, Semrush o. Ä.) Du hast kein Problem damit, täglich viele Vorgänge diszipliniert abzuarbeiten Du nutzt KI jeden Tag. Mit ChatGPT, Claude oder ähnlichen Werkzeugen machst du Mails, Texte und Auswertungen schneller, und du prüfst, was sie liefern. Du meldest Probleme, bevor jemand fragt, und wartest nicht auf Anweisungen. Du willst Feedback. Sagt dir jemand, was nicht funktioniert hat, machst du es beim nächsten Mal besser. Du bezeichnest dich selbst als zuverlässig, schnell, hungrig, entwicklungsbereit Was wir dir bieten Klare Verantwortlichkeit für einen Kernbereich unseres Geschäfts (Fulfillment, Offpage & Publisher) Klare Ziele statt Micromanagement: du bekommst KPIs und den Rahmen, den Rest regelst du Entwicklungsoptionen Richtung Lead Offpage SEO / Teamlead Publisher Management Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit fester Erreichbarkeit, Remote‑Option, 40h/Woche Faires, transparentes Gehaltspaket mit Entwicklungsmöglichkeit (Range: 35.000 € - 45.000 € brutto jährlich, je nach Erfahrung) Unsere Werte Nach diesen vier Werten stellen wir ein, geben Feedback und entscheiden, wer mehr Verantwortung bekommt. Ergebnisse zählen. Jede Aufgabe hat ein Ergebnis und einen Termin. Deine Zahlen kennst du, bevor jemand fragt. Schnell entscheiden. Fragen sind am selben Tag geklärt. Eine gute Entscheidung heute ist uns lieber als eine perfekte nächste Woche. Direktes Feedback. Wir sagen sofort, was gut war und was nicht, in beide Richtungen. Feedback setzt du beim nächsten Versuch um. Verantwortung vom ersten Tag. Wer ein Problem sieht, kümmert sich darum. Was zweimal von Hand passiert, baust du beim dritten Mal als festen Ablauf oder gemeinsam mit unserer DEV-Abteilung als Prozess. So bewirbst du dich Nutzen Sie den Bewerben-Button auf dieser Seite, um uns Ihre Unterlagen zu senden. Danach geht es so weiter: Runde 1: Gespräch per Video, 15 Minuten. Wir stellen Rolle, Ziele und Werte vor und stellen/beantworten alle Fragen. Runde 2: Arbeitsprobe. Du bekommst ein echtes Kundenprojekt und eine Liste von Domains. Du wählst die passenden Publisher aus, begründest die Auswahl und baust daraus einen kleinen Plan. Ebenfalls stellen wir Dir 2 weitere Test-Aufgaben zur Verfügung. Runde 3: Live-Übung per Video, 30 Minuten. Gewünschter Arbeitsbeginn: Ab 01.11.2026 bis spätestens 01.01.2027 Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE Supabase manages millions of Postgres instances and is growing. We have strong teams across observability, release engineering, and incident management — and we're concentrating our reliability efforts into a dedicated SRE practice that ties the discipline together across the platform. You'll be embedded within Service Operations, and your primary job is to make every engineering team more reliable — not by owning their infrastructure, but by establishing the practices, frameworks, and feedback loops that let them own reliability themselves. You'll work across the org: sometimes setting the standard, sometimes pair-programming a fix, sometimes helping a team define their error budget, sometimes telling them it's exhausted. This role is ideal for someone who has a strong vision for how SRE should work and thrives in async, fast-paced environments where influence matters more than authority. WHAT YOU'LL OWN - Partner with service teams to define meaningful SLIs and SLOs grounded in customer experience, and build the error budget policies that turn them into engineering decisions - Own and evolve the Operational Readiness Review (ORR) process — conducting reviews for new services and major changes across observability, alerting, runbooks, capacity, and graceful degradation - Strengthen the incident-to-improvement pipeline: connecting postmortem findings to operational readiness gaps, identifying repeat failure patterns, and driving systemic fixes - Act as the reliability expert teams pull in for architecture reviews, failure mode analysis, dependency mapping, and resilience design - Identify and quantify operational toil across the org, and build or advocate for automation that eliminates it - Help teams design sustainable on-call practices: alert quality, escalation paths, runbook coverage, and noise reduction - Track and report on org-wide operational maturity, surfacing systemic gaps and driving remediation YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU - Have 7+ years of experience in SRE, production engineering, or reliability-focused roles, including experience shaping SRE practices and driving adoption across engineering teams - Have a software engineering mindset — you write code and build tools, not just configure them - Have hands-on experience defining and operationalizing SLOs/SLIs at scale, including error budget policies that actually influenced engineering decisions - Have deep experience with incident response, postmortem facilitation, and turning incident learnings into systemic improvements - Have worked with large-scale multi-tenant systems (bonus: managed database platforms or Postgres) - Are proficient with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) and infrastructure-as-code (Pulumi preferred, Terraform/CDK also acceptable) - Communicate clearly and persuasively — this role requires influencing without authority across a distributed org - Have experience in async or globally distributed teams - Are energized by making other teams more effective rather than being the one who fixes everything NICE TO HAVE - Experience with Kubernetes-based platform operations - Familiarity with OpenTelemetry, VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, or similar observability tooling - Experience building developer-facing reliability tooling (SLO dashboards, ORR frameworks, toil tracking, DORA metrics) WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Sales Manager (w/m/d) Retail | DACH
description: Unser Partner, ein mittelständisches Technologieunternehmen im Retail Umfeld, sucht einen erfahrenen Sales Manager (w/m/d) , der den internationalen Vertrieb innovativer Plattform-Lösungen bei Handelsunternehmen im DACH-Raum und auf ausgewählten europäischen Märkten vorantreibt. Das Unternehmen entwickelt und betreibt eine leistungsstarke Retail-Plattform, die Checkout-, Kassen- und Paymentprozesse großer Handelspartner vereint. Die Lösungen reichen von maßgeschneiderter Softwareentwicklung bis zu skalierbaren SaaS- und Lizenzmodellen – immer mit dem Ziel, komplexe Handelsprozesse effizienter und zukunftsfähiger zu gestalten. title: Consultant Psychiatrist PAYE
description: An opportunity to help patients who have run out of options For many people living with chronic pain, the journey has been long. They have tried multiple medications, procedures and therapies, yet their pain continues to impact every aspect of daily life. By the time they reach us, many are looking for another option where conventional treatment has fallen short. We are Montu UK, one of the UK's largest medical cannabis clinics, and we are looking for Consultants specialising in Pain Management to join our clinical team. About the role You will assess and manage patients exploring cannabis based medicines, making the clinical decision on whether treatment is appropriate and managing their care from there. This is an evolving area of medicine where the evidence base continues to grow, giving you the opportunity to help shape how cannabis based medicines are used within pain management in the UK. You do not need previous experience with cannabis based medicines. We are looking for experienced Pain Management Consultants with sound clinical judgement, an open mind and a genuine interest in improving outcomes for patients with complex chronic pain. We provide comprehensive specialist training, and our multidisciplinary model means you are never working in isolation. Nurses and pharmacists complete pre consultation and follow up prescribing tasks, allowing you to focus on clinical decision making and patient care. What you will be doing: Provide high quality care for patients seeking medical cannabis treatment. Conduct patient consultations, including assessment and ongoing management. Engage in clinical outcome data collection to support evidence based practices. Contribute to clinical governance and maintain robust patient care standards. Collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary team, including nurses and pharmacists. Participate in ongoing training and professional development, including bespoke specialist training in cannabis based medicines (CBMPs). What you need: Full GMC Registration Completion of Specialist Training (CCST/CCT) or equivalent certification On the GMC Specialist Register for Pain Demonstrated interest in alternative therapies Willingness to participate in data collection and reporting Why join us? Highly Competitive Salary: £190,000 - £275,000 FTE, pro rata for part time roles based on experience and hours worked. Flexible Working: Full time or part time options available Comprehensive Indemnity Coverage: Montu will cover all professional and clinical indemnity insurance for your work with us Private Healthcare Work-Life Balance: No night shifts or on call requirements Cutting Edge Training: Access to CPD accredited medical cannabis education and specialist in house training from industry leaders Collaborative Environment: Join a multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals Personal Growth: Be part of a pioneering field and shape the future of medical cannabis care in the UK Training & Development: Attendance at a recognised Medical Cannabis Course for Specialist Physicians (sponsored by Montu) Specialist training delivered by experts, including Prof Anup Mathew (Consultant Psychiatrist) and Dr Gerard Sinovich (Pain Management Consultant). Ongoing support and training on clinical protocols, prescribing practices, and Montu’s system usage Working arrangements: Remote Role: Flexible working hours and days Session Structure: Standard session length: 4 hours Appointment duration: 15 minutes (new and existing patients) Montu’s multidisciplinary model allows consultants to focus on prescribing and patient care, while nurses and pharmacists handle pre consultation and follow up tasks. If you are passionate about innovative patient care, thrive in a dynamic environment, and are looking to make a real impact in the field of medical cannabis, we would love to hear from you! Sessions: Each standard session consists of 4 hours of patient consultations. Clinicians can choose their preferred working days and hours, with sessions spread flexibly if needed. To support onboarding, clinicians are required to commit to a minimum of 2 sessions per week/ 8 hours initially, to ensure they become proficient with Montu’s platform. Appointment Durations: Appointments are 15 minutes in length for new and existing patients as Montu operates a multidisciplinary approach, leveraging a clinical skills mix where nurses and pharmacists handle pre-consultation and follow-up prescribing tasks allowing Consultants to focus on prescribing and patient care. About MONTU Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis based medicines (CBPM). We are committed to transforming lives by improving access to safe, effective treatments and offering an exceptional standard of care. Our dynamic and supportive work environment is the perfect place for you to grow professionally while making a meaningful impact on patients’ lives. title: Director, Luxury Market Intelligence & Insights
description: We are growing! We are currently looking to hire a Director, Luxury Market Intelligence & Insights . About CXG: Founded in 2006, CXG is a global customer experience company uniquely positioned at the intersection of data-driven retail performance, customer experience transformation, and operational execution across 200+ luxury brands worldwide. The mission of our 270 collaborators is to help brands transform customer and employee experiences through tailored insights, strategy, and implementation. We are passionate about delivering impact. Our clients include the world's most admired luxury houses, and our solutions combine research, technology, and human expertise to elevate every customer interaction. We are looking for a thought leadership expert with the editorial vision to spot what matters next, the conviction to shape CXG's point of view, and the writing talent to make it influential across luxury retail, beauty and cosmetics, watches and jewellery, automotive, and hospitality. Context and role Reporting to the Chief of Staff, you will lead CXG's Thought Leadership and Market Intelligence functions. You will define the topics on which CXG should have a distinctive and credible point of view, turn CXG's proprietary data, expertise and market knowledge into original external content, and position the company ahead of emerging developments in customer experience, luxury and its priority verticals. This is a hands-on role: you will research, analyse, write and produce content yourself, while mobilising expertise and data from across the business. You will be accountable for ensuring that every publication presents a recognisable CXG angle rather than simply reporting market developments or repeating established industry views. You will manage one Market Intelligence team member. Thought Leadership Development Define the thought leadership strategy and roadmap, including priority themes, target audiences, formats and a realistic publication calendar. Drive and coordinate content creation across Practices, Solutions and Regions. Work closely with Practices, Regions and Solutions to: Push: scan for trends and hot topics and ensure CXG has a voice and perspective, commenting regularly on these subjects. Pull: identify and collect new ideas and proposed topics from the relevant stakeholders, prioritise and incorporate them into the thought leadership roadmap. Use market intelligence, CXG's proprietary data, internal expertise and client-facing insights to identify emerging topics early, develop a clear CXG point of view and decide where CXG can make a credible contribution to the conversation. Research, interview internal experts, write and edit articles, perspectives and other thought leadership content directly. Challenge generic claims and ensure each piece advances a clear argument and is supported by credible evidence. Ensure that analysis is methodologically sound, appropriately contextualised and presented without compromising client confidentiality. Develop topics that connect expertise across Practices and Regions, while reflecting relevant differences between markets. Thought Leadership Communication Ensure relevant thought leadership pieces (e.g., perspectives, publications) are disseminated on a periodic basis. Work with Marketing on the publication, distribution and promotion of content, while retaining ownership of the editorial strategy, substance, quality and consistency of CXG's point of view. In addition, collaborate with Marketing to maximise impact by communicating through the channels relevant to each market. Track the reach, engagement and qualitative response generated by CXG's thought leadership, as well as relevant business enquiries influenced by published content. Use the findings to refine the roadmap. Shape and host or contribute to CXG's podcast "The Luxury Edit", working with internal experts and guests to develop topics, prepare interviews and turn conversations into useful content. Develop the content and key messages for CXG-hosted events and external conferences, panels and talks; act as a CXG speaker where appropriate; and work with internal experts to prepare other CXG speakers and turn the company's point of view into compelling presentations and discussion topics. Look for and test new thought leadership formats (e.g., interactive reports, data visualisations, short-form video, newsletters, social-first content) to broaden reach, engage new audiences and keep CXG's content distinctive. Identify and build collaborations with conferences, specialised industry magazines and universities (e.g., content partnerships, guest articles, co-branded publications, joint research, guest lectures, speaking slots) to extend CXG's visibility and credibility with target audiences. Market Intelligence Keep abreast of market and competitive developments and ensure relevant findings are communicated across CXG. Translate these findings into clear implications for CXG's strategic priorities, client conversations, commercial opportunities and external thought leadership. Contribute market intelligence, evidence and relevant CXG perspectives to priority proposals and client deliverables, working with Practices, Solutions and Regions to strengthen the quality and relevance of the final output. Manage and develop the Market Intelligence team member, setting clear priorities and reviewing the quality and usefulness of their work. Competitive Analysis Develop and continuously update a list of CXG competitors. Research competitor performance, including revenues and market share where reliable information is available. Identify and assess the impact of new competitors' offerings. Review competitors' thought leadership, influence and presence. Identify gaps in the conversations competitors are leading and opportunities for CXG to establish a distinct position. Industry Analysis Research and review clients' developments (e.g., new strategy, launch of new product or service, restructuring, M&A, key managerial appointments). Track public financial announcements (e.g., quarterly and annual earnings). Monitor developments in luxury, retail, customer experience and adjacent sectors; distinguish lasting shifts from short-lived topics and explain their implications for CXG and its clients. Publish the weekly "This Week in Luxury" news brief and issue timely flash updates when significant developments require immediate attention, such as financial announcements, major transactions or leadership changes. Internal Dissemination and Application Synthesise research and findings into concise, actionable outputs tailored to the needs of relevant internal stakeholders. Feed findings into the Thought Leadership roadmap. Proactively bring relevant market signals to Practices, Regions and leadership early enough to inform decisions, client conversations and potential cross-practice opportunities. Disseminate new thought leadership across CXG and equip Practices, Regions and client-facing teams with the key messages and supporting materials needed to use it in client conversations and commercial activities. Requirements What will you bring along? Proven experience developing thought leadership, editorial content or insight-led communications in a consulting, research, customer experience, retail or luxury environment. Excellent English writing and editing skills, with a portfolio demonstrating original, well-argued, evidence-led articles or publications written personally. If possible, include examples that turn proprietary research, data or specialist expertise into a distinctive point of view. Additional languages (e.g., French, Mandarin) are a plus. Strong oral communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to represent CXG as a speaker at conferences, panels and client events. Proven ability to build relationships and influence senior stakeholders across functions and regions without direct authority. An established network or demonstrated ability to build partnerships with media, conference organisers, academic institutions or industry bodies. Comfort working with quantitative data and research methods, and the ability to translate data into clear, credible narratives and visualisations. Ability to define and track content performance indicators and use them to refine editorial priorities. Strong research and analytical skills: able to assess sources critically, connect market signals and form a clear point of view rather than simply summarise trends. Familiarity with AI-assisted research and content tools, used with appropriate rigour. Sound knowledge of luxury, retail and customer experience, and curiosity about how these sectors are evolving across markets. Ability to interview senior experts, challenge ideas constructively and turn specialist knowledge into accessible, credible content. Comfort working independently in a remote setting, managing an editorial roadmap and delivering finished work without a large production team. Experience managing or coaching at least one team member. Confidence preparing and hosting interviews or podcasts is a plus. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: iOS Developer
description: iOS Developer – Maatwerk Software met Impact Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij. Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Binnen onze Smart Devices afdeling bouwen we apps die impact maken. Van media apps voor bedrijven als Pathé en RTL met miljoenen gebruikers, tot de app van het KNMI waarmee we belangrijke weerswaarschuwingen zoals code rood meldingen afgeven. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details. Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een ervaren iOS Developer . Iemand die energie krijgt van het bouwen aan apps die miljoenen mensen dagelijks gebruiken. Je denkt verder dan code alleen en werkt graag samen aan betekenisvolle producten. Jouw rol Als iOS Developer ben je een ervaren software engineer die graag kennis deelt binnen een hecht team. Je zet de gebruikerservaring altijd centraal en bouwt mee aan stabiele, schaalbare mobiele architecturen. De techstack met Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, MVVM-C en TCA is voor jou bekend terrein. Je werkt nauw samen met product owners, testers en Android engineers aan complete platformen. Samen vertalen jullie complexe klantvragen naar vloeiende mobiele applicaties. Je krijgt de vrijheid om jouw expertise in te zetten en processen continu te verbeteren. Wat je gaat doen: Je bouwt mee aan bekende applicaties voor platformen zoals NPO Start, RTL Boulevard en het KNMI. Je deelt jouw kennis binnen een mobile team van 35 specialisten. Je vertaalt designs naar vloeiende animaties en intuïtieve interfaces. Je waarborgt de codekwaliteit via code reviews en testautomatisering. Je adviseert klanten over de beste technische keuzes voor hun platform. Je levert een actieve bijdrage aan onze eigen kennisevents, zoals Appdevcon. Wie ben jij? Je hebt minstens vijf jaar ervaring met mobile development en ontwikkelt zelfstandig native iOS applicaties . Je bent blijvend leergierig en past je snel aan in een veranderende omgeving. De techstack met Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, MVVM-C en TCA is voor jou bekend terrein. Samenwerken in een divers team is voor jou vanzelfsprekend. Je toont eigenaarschap en kijkt kritisch naar je eigen werk om de hoogste kwaliteit te garanderen. Verder ben je woonachtig in Nederland . Wat bieden wij jou? De Organisatie: Snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software. Autonomie: Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie. Maatschappelijke Impact: De kans om bij te dragen aan bekende, maatschappelijk relevante applicaties voor platformen zoals NPO Start, RTL Boulevard en het KNMI. Salaris: Bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4000,- en €6500,- passend bij jouw ervaring. Vakantiedagen: 25 vakantiedagen om lekker uit te rusten. Werkplek & Sfeer: Een fijne remote-first cultuur met volledige flexibiliteit, een gezellige werksfeer en inspirerende maandelijkse co-working dagen. Mobiliteit & Thuiswerken: Kilometervergoeding van €0,25/km of volledige OV-vergoeding, gecombineerd met een maandelijkse thuiswerkvergoeding. Pensioen: Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen. Ontwikkeling & Extra's: Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen, plus actieve deelname en toegang tot het eigen event Appdevcon en diverse kennissessies. Lead the architecture, scalability, security, observability, and cost efficiency of infrastructure handling over 4 million requests per second. Strong coding skills in at least two languages, with a focus on automation and maintainable tooling. Experience leading complex incidents and driving lasting operational improvements. Ability to set technical direction, influence across teams, mentor engineers, and communicate clearly. Comfortable making pragmatic decisions in ambiguous situations and balancing technical and business priorities. Calm, collaborative, and committed to blameless operations. Fluent in English. title: FinOps Data Engineer
description: About the Role We're looking for a FinOps Data Engineer to help drive cost optimization and cloud financial governance across our AWS infrastructure and GCP footprint. You'll work cross-functionally with Engineering, Finance, and Product to find and ship savings, build the tooling necessary to maximize efficiency of every dollar spent in the cloud, and cultivate a culture of cost awareness across engineering teams. This role owns the data side of that mission: the models, pipelines, and analysis that make cost, usage, and margin numbers trustworthy across the company. This is a hands-on engineering role, not an analyst seat. You'll do the schlep work other teams don't have time for, digging into a bucket's access pattern, writing the dbt model or Python pipeline that ships the fix, building the cost-vs-revenue mart that answers a margin question once instead of every time, and chasing a number until it reconciles. Strong communication matters as much as technical depth, you'll regularly explain a savings case or a data model's implications to an engineering team, a finance stakeholder, and a leadership audience in the same week. What You'll Be Responsible For In this role, you'll: - Find and ship savings across AWS and GCP: Analyze billing, usage, and cost trends to identify opportunities, rightsizing, storage lifecycle policies, data transfer, and spot/auto-scaling. Take ideas from identification through to a realized dollar figure, not just a recommendation. - Build and maintain the FinOps data pipeline: Design and run the BigQuery/dbt models that turn raw billing and usage data (CUR, Storage Lens) into reconciled, trustworthy mart tables, the foundation everything else in FinOps is built on. - Build cost-vs-revenue and customer segmentation models: Model unit economics and margin by product line and customer segment, and extend coverage as new products and segments come online. - Apply data science to cost and usage data: Build forecasting models, detect anomalies statistically rather than by threshold alone, and quantify savings opportunities (e.g. storage lifecycle, request-cost patterns) with rigor a spreadsheet can't match. - Build and maintain cost attribution: Tagging policies, cost allocation, and chargeback/showback so engineering teams can see and own their own spend. This is foundational work other savings work depends on. - Automate cost governance: Build automated cost reporting, anomaly detection, and alerting. Write the scripts and infrastructure-as-code (Python, Terraform, Lambda) that enforce cost policy rather than relying on manual review. - Partner with engineering on architecture decisions: Bring cost into the room early, cost-efficiencies are cheaper to get right at design than to retrofit. - Work with Finance on forecasting and reporting: Support budget tracking and financial KPIs; build dashboards and self-serve analytics engineering and finance can both read. You Might Be a Good Fit If You - Have strong AWS expertise and working GCP knowledge, including pricing models, billing structures, and cost optimization mechanics. - Have data engineering depth: dbt, BigQuery (or an equivalent modern warehouse), SQL at scale, and data modeling for analytics (dimensional modeling, incremental models, testing). - Have data science fundamentals: statistical forecasting, anomaly detection, and experimentation, and know when a rigorous model beats a rule of thumb. - Have automation and scripting skills: Python, Terraform/ pulumi, Lambda, or Bash. - Are comfortable with cost/billing tooling: AWS Cost Explorer, Cost & Usage Reports, GCP Billing Reports, and BI/dashboarding (we use Hex). - Have experience with, or are comfortable picking up, Linear and Notion as the system of record for tracking and documenting FinOps work. - Experience with a dedicated cloud cost management platform (e.g. CloudZero, Vantage, or similar) is a plus, not required. - Can analyze cost data and present it clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. - Have prior experience spanning data analytics, data engineering, or data science in a FinOps, cloud cost management, or cloud governance context. - Are energized by doing the unglamorous, high-leverage work (the schlep) that unblocks other teams, and by working cross-functionally without positional authority. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.
