title: Technical Customer Support
description: QuickMail is a cold email and LinkedIn outreach platform for markets you can't afford to burn. Our customers can't easily replace leads that land in spam, which is why deliverability matters more to us than anything else. We have been running since 2014, and we pioneered deliverability technology such as Inbox rotationâ¢ and deliverability AIâ¢. The Role We are hiring a technical customer support person with an owner's mentality. You will own support for QuickMail and Mailflow, our deliverability add-on. There is no first or second line. You are the first and last person our customers talk to. Customers count on you to solve their problems and find the real cause when something breaks. You work closely with engineering, and you tell the founder what we need to know to make the product better: where the friction is and where the opportunities are. The role covers the help desk, system health checks, testing new releases before they ship, and leading the weekly team meeting. It takes excellent communication, solid technical understanding and sharp critical thinking. This is not a script-reading job. Most tickets involve deliverability, DNS records, LinkedIn automation or campaign setup. You dig into customer accounts in our Support Dashboard, reproduce the issue, then decide what to do and how to explain it to the customer. We are a remote team spread across time zones. Most routine tasks have a written guide with a checklist, so you know what done looks like. You are expected to refine and improve those processes. When something new comes up, you work out the most efficient way to handle it. If you want a lot of autonomy across many areas, real responsibility and a fast-paced environment, this role is for you. What Work Looks Like You own two things: customers get unstuck fast, and the product stays reliable. Every day Set the day's support priorities and work the Help Scout queue for QuickMail and Mailflow. Triage, resolve, and dig deeper when a ticket needs it. Check the support dashboard: job queue, event-stream latency, blacklist status, newly purchased domains. If something is off, investigate, diagnose, and drive it to resolution. Review fraud alerts and disable accounts that are scams or abusing the platform. Delighting customers Comfortable jumping on calls with customers, building rapport fast, and setting them up for success. Update the changelog and help articles based on what shipped and what customers asked. Share customer feedback with the team, ask happy customers for reviews and case studies, and watch NPS for testimonial candidates. Making support smarter with AI Improve the AI support agent. Review its answers, fix the docs it drew from when it is wrong, and contact the customer when its reply was off. Write and maintain automated tests, built with AI, that try to break staging before customers do. Use the MCP connections we have in place (Helpscout, GitHub, Postmark, and others) to get an accurate picture of support and find the next thing worth improving. Keeping the product solid Gatekeep releases. New fixes and features land on staging every week. Test them, confirm when staging is ready to ship, and think through how existing and new users will be affected. Report bugs as GitHub issues with everything the developer needs: steps to reproduce, screenshots or a Loom, and any GraphQL or console errors. Captain red alerts. When a core feature breaks (emails not sending, login down), confirm it, alert the team on Slack or Telegram, update the status page every 30 minutes, keep affected customers informed, and drive the fix. Then run the retrospective so it does not happen twice. Running the week Lead the weekly team meeting in MonsterOps: issues written up, to-dos done, numbers updated. Keep rock status and KPIs current in MonsterOps. Tools you'll use: Helpscout, our Support Dashboard, Sidekiq, GitHub, Slack, Telegram, MonsterOps, Outline, MxToolbox, Postmark, Bento, TidyCal, Fathom, Visual Code and Claude. Who You Are You build rapport fast. You are warm, positive, and relatable in writing and on calls. You are a good communicator. Externally, you can show warmth, empathy and care. Internally, you are able to communicate clearly and concisely about important things. You can operate with minimal instructions. You understand a short brief without every detail spelled out. You can prioritize well (especially when you have a lot on your plate), and get things done without hand-holding. You are comfortable on video. You are natural on live calls with Zoom and Meet, and on recorded video through tools like Loom. Your teammates can always count on you. You say what you'll do and you do what you said. You act with a constant sense of urgency. You can execute fast and find new ways to improve your productivity. You are resourceful. You use all the tools at your disposal to get great results. You have a low ego. You don't take offense easily and you handle disagreement as a discussion, not a personal attack. Growth mindset. You are positive about new workflow/process/product/tool changes. You love giving and receiving positive and negative feedback without getting defensive. Hours that overlap with East coast US and UK, where most of our customers are. A Plus If You Have Experience with customer facing work, or if you don't have it, tell us why you are perfect for this role. Working knowledge of deliverability and LinkedIn outreach. Warmup, DNS, inbox rotation, DKIM, SPF, Outlook and Gmail technical setup. We can teach this, but a head start helps. Comfort with agency setups. Workspaces, guest seats, inbox purchases and what happens when an agency loses a client. Light data skills. You can pull numbers from Help Scout or our MCP to back up what you report. An eye for happy customers. You notice them and ask for testimonials and case studies at the right moment. How We Work Together You'll work directly with the founder and with our lead developer. Working with the founder can be intense. Here is what that looks like in practice: Replies are short and can come across as harsh. If something written lands badly or isn't clear, ask. Direction can change. The founder may say one thing, then something different a few days later as they learn more. When that happens, check what changed and adapt. Information should be short and to the point. Lead with what matters, then give more details if asked. The founder can stay frustrated about a problem until it's solved. That's something they are aware of and working on. You'll do well here if you can stay calm and focused when the pressure is on. The team often thinks fast and interrupts each other when discussing ideas. If that would bother you, this role probably isn't for you. This role suits someone with high emotional intelligence, who doesn't take things personally, asks when something is unclear, and keeps many things moving at once. Your schedule can be flexible. If you have a martial arts class every Thursday at 3 pm, go and make up the time later. In return, on the rare occasion the team needs your help on a weekend, we ask you to be flexible too. About the role ElevenLabs is looking for a Value Strategist to help our customers identify, quantify, and realize the business value of ElevenLabs across our portfolio, with a primary focus on ElevenAgents. This is a senior individual contributor role within our global Revenue organization, spanning the full customer lifecycle from early sales conversations through proof of concept, deployment, renewal, and expansion. On our most strategic accounts, Deployment Strategists in our Forward Deployed Engineering team already build account-specific business cases and ROI narratives as part of delivery. You will partner with them rather than duplicate that work. Your mandate is the value discipline across the whole book: the Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Commercial accounts where no one is embedded, and where value today is quantified deal by deal or not at all. You will build the frameworks, benchmarks, calculators, and playbooks that let every seller articulate and measure value consistently, and you will use what you learn from strategic deployments to make that methodology sharper. This is not a quota-carrying role, nor is it a traditional advisory function. We are looking for a builder and a doer: someone who can engage credibly with senior customer stakeholders, get deep into a customer's operations and data, build rigorous models themselves, and turn ambiguous business problems into clear, actionable recommendations. You will define how ElevenLabs understands, measures, and communicates customer value globally. In this role you will Shape value from the beginning. Partner with Revenue teams and prospects early in the sales cycle to understand customer priorities, identify high-value opportunities, and establish the business case for investing in ElevenLabs. Scale what works. Turn bespoke work with our largest customers into repeatable approaches that enable our Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Commercial teams to articulate and measure value without requiring bespoke support for every customer. Identify where ElevenLabs can have the greatest impact. Define how value will be proven. Establish success metrics and measurement approaches for proofs of concept and deployments so that customers and ElevenLabs have a shared understanding of what success looks like from the outset. Measure value realization. Partner with customers and internal teams after deployment to understand the impact ElevenLabs is delivering, identify gaps between expected and realized value, and determine where additional opportunities exist. Support expansion and long-term customer value. Use insights from existing deployments to help customers understand what they have achieved and identify where ElevenLabs can drive additional impact. Work directly with the data. Analyze customer and industry data, build models, pressure-test assumptions, and develop recommendations yourself. You should be equally comfortable working in the details and communicating the implications. Partner with Deployment. On strategic accounts, work alongside Deployment Strategists who own the account-level business case, contributing methodology and capturing what works into reusable assets. Across the rest of the book, be the primary owner of value quantification and measurement. Influence senior stakeholders. Communicate complex analysis simply and credibly, and engage with senior leaders internally and externally when the opportunity requires it. Requirements 10+ years of relevant experience across operating roles, strategy, management consulting, analytics, finance, customer strategy, or other roles requiring rigorous business problem solving. Strong operating judgment. You understand how businesses work and can quickly get underneath a customer's operating model, workflows, economics, and strategic priorities. Exceptional analytical ability. You can personally build sophisticated financial and operational models, work with incomplete or imperfect information, make assumptions explicit, and turn analysis into decisions. Structured problem solving. You are comfortable starting with an ambiguous question such as "Where could AI create the most value in this business?" and developing a rigorous approach to answering it. Customer credibility. You can work directly with customers across functions and levels, ask incisive questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and establish trust quickly. Commercial judgment. You understand how business value connects to technology investment decisions and can partner closely with Revenue teams while maintaining an objective, customer-first perspective. Excellent communication. You can distill complex analysis into a clear point of view and communicate it effectively in writing and verbally, from working teams through senior executives. A builder mentality. You are excited to start by doing the work yourself, learn from customers, and turn what works into scalable methodologies and tools. Comfort with ambiguity and pace. You can move quickly across industries, customer types, and use cases while maintaining a high bar for analytical rigor. Ability to operate globally. You are comfortable partnering with teams and customers across regions and traveling when valuable for customer work. Willingness to travel. Must be willing and able to travel up to 10% of the time. Bonus points Experience in strategy or management consulting, particularly in operational transformation, technology, customer experience, or growth. Experience as an operator within a technology company or other fast-moving business. Experience working on AI, automation, customer experience, or technology-enabled business transformation. Experience developing business cases, value frameworks, or analytical methodologies that were ultimately scaled beyond an individual project or customer. Experience working with enterprise customers on complex, cross-functional initiatives. Location This is a global role within the Revenue organization. The role can be based in San Francisco or remotely, with the option to work from our San Francisco office. You will work with customers and ElevenLabs teams across regions and should expect travel for customer meetings and onsite work when it meaningfully advances the work. title: Platform Engineer, Managed Postgres
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking a Platform Software Engineer with deep experience in distributed systems to help design, build, and maintain core platform services. You will work primarily in TypeScript and Go to deliver reliable, scalable, and secure systems that power Supabase at massive scale. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING: - Design and implement distributed services and APIs that power the Supabase Platform. - Lead projects that improve scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency across existing systems. - Build data-intensive workflows, background jobs, and event-driven pipelines. - Own service SLIs/SLOs and collaborate on incident response and post-incident reviews. - Improve system observability with metrics, logging, tracing, and profiling. - Contribute to our CI/CD and release processes to ship safely and quickly. - Partner with product teams to deliver features end-to-end, from design docs to production. - Write clear design documents, RFCs, and high-quality tests. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR: - Experienced in designing and operating distributed systems, with strong foundations in consistency, fault tolerance, partitioning, consensus, and back pressure. - Proficient in TypeScript and/or Go, ideally with 5+ years building production services in one or both languages (other languages also considered). - Comfortable with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) and container orchestration. - Familiar with multi-tenant architectures, API design, and data modelling. - Knowledgeable about networking fundamentals and security best practices. - Experienced with Infrastructure as Code (Pulumi preferred; Terraform/CDK also fine). - Comfortable participating in on-call rotations for large-scale production systems. NICE TO HAVE: - Experience with Postgres internals, logical replication, or CDC pipelines. - Experience with service meshes, workload identity, or zero-trust networking. - Background in performance engineering and capacity planning. - Open source contributions in systems, databases, or runtime tooling. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Cloud Platform Engineer
description: ABOUT THE ROLE As a Cloud Platform Engineer at Supabase, you’ll join Cloud Engineering, part of Engineering Operations, and shape the foundations that let engineering teams build, ship, and operate infrastructure safely and independently across AWS and GCP. This is a role spanning cloud governance, platform engineering, and hands-on operations. You’ll work across AWS and GCP account structure, identity and access management, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), reusable platform primitives, security boundaries, and self-service workflows for engineers. You’ll be joining at a point where many of these foundations are being actively defined or reworked. We’re looking for someone who can take ambiguous, messy, business-critical infrastructure problems and turn them into pragmatic systems, tools, standards, and written guidance that scale with the company and empower teams to go faster. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - Designing and implementing cloud governance across AWS and GCP, including identity, account organization, access controls, and guardrails. - Building reusable infrastructure and building blocks using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), enabling teams to provision and manage infrastructure safely and consistently. - Creating self-service capabilities that reduce organizational friction and let engineers move more quickly within sensible boundaries. - Owning resource governance and visibility: management tagging, a trustworthy inventory of what exists and who owns it, and consistent cross-account billing data. - Developing reusable security primitives, including secrets storage, KMS, certificate management, token vending, direct service-to-service authentication, mTLS, and related platform services. - Owning cloud-level network and operational primitives: IP address management, DNS, and health signals such as service-limit and quota alerting. - Combining software engineering with hands-on operations and total ownership: building, deploying, monitoring, troubleshooting, and improving what you own. - Establishing and sharing cloud engineering best practices through documentation, internal tooling, examples, and enablement. YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU - Have 5+ years of experience in cloud governance, platform engineering, and/or operations, have operated production systems at scale, and carried on-call for them. - Have previously undertaken a significant migration, e.g. rearchitected an AWS account topology, introduced IaC for existing infrastructure, centralized identity/SSO, or brought a second cloud under governance. - Enjoy building internal platform and self-service experiences for other engineers. - Are genuinely deep in at least one—ideally two—of the three strength areas below (and tell us which is your center of gravity): - Tooling & ecosystem: You’re intimately familiar with the breadth of AWS services in general, and IAM/SSO in particular. You know their Well-Architected Framework, and when to reach outside. You have working knowledge of GCP. You use IaC routinely and have run it in production, whichever tool. You’ve probably collaborated with auditors on meeting compliance requirements. - Software engineering: You write real production code (Go, Rust, or a comparable systems language), and can build reliable, maintainable services. You thrive across all stages of the SDLC, set technical direction, know how to de-risk projects, and produce written artifacts such as RFCs. - Operations: You’ve run production infrastructure yourself: carried the pager, written the alerts and runbooks, used SLOs or similar to decide what to fix first, and made shared systems less risky over time. You like owning systems, simplifying complex infrastructure problems, and turning best practices into reusable building blocks. - Are comfortable treating infrastructure as software and have relevant experience with IaC and automation. - Communicate clearly, work with a wide range of stakeholders, and thrive in async, globally distributed teams. - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and iterating toward better systems over time. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Product Design Lead
description: Fuel50 is a workforce transformation platform helping organisations understand workforce capability, build skills and enable internal mobility in an AI-driven world. Our products combine skills intelligence, talent marketplace experiences and responsible AI to help people and organisations take their next step.Â We are looking for a Product Design Lead to shape the next chapter of our product experience and design organisation.Â This is a senior player-coach role. You will lead and develop our product design team while staying close to the work, setting direction, shaping product strategy, prototyping ideas and helping teams ship high-quality experiences.Â You will work closely with Product and Engineering as a leadership trio, influencing decisions across the organisation and helping Fuel50 build products that are simple, trusted and valuable.Â If youâre a strategic design leader who still loves getting close to the work, developing people and shipping real product, weâd love to hear from you!Â What you'll do: Lead, manage and coach our product designers, supporting their growth and helping them reach their next level.Â Set and communicate a clear product design vision across Fuel50's skills intelligence, talent mobility and AI-powered experiences, and tell the story of where our products are going in a way that excites customers, colleagues and leadership.Â Own the design direction without waiting for it to be handed to you. Spot opportunities, form a point of view, and prototype ideas to make them tangible.Â Bring a strong point of view to senior conversations, challenge assumptions constructively and influence decisions across the business.Â Partner with Product and Engineering from discovery through to delivery, balancing customer value, design quality, technical reality and pace.Â Design human-centred AI experiences with appropriate trust, explainability, user control and clear handoffs, including agent and assistant experiences that work across multiple surfaces such as the Fuel50 platform, Microsoft Teams and Copilot.Â Grow our design engineering capability, and be comfortable building and shipping working prototypes or code yourself.Â Evolve our design system, accessibility standards (including WCAG compliance) and design-to-code practices so Fuel50 feels coherent and high quality across every product.Â Shape design team structure, capability, hiring, planning and ways of working as the organisation evolves.Â What you'll bring: Experience in product design in a SaaS or technology environment (we suggest 7 or more years), including at least 2 years leading, managing or coaching designers, and a track record of building healthy, high-performing teams.Â Strong product design craft across discovery, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, research and shipped digital products.Â Experience designing complex, connected systems and journeys for multiple personas, ideally in an enterprise or B2B product.Â The ability to think big and set a compelling vision, while staying pragmatic about what can be learned and shipped next.Â The ability to originate ideas and direction, and to communicate them clearly through stories, prototypes and design narrative.Â Confidence working with experienced senior stakeholders and influencing through clarity, judgement and strong communication.Â Experience working closely with Product and Engineering as a genuine cross-functional trio.Â Technical fluency and a willingness to get into the code. You should be comfortable building working prototypes using HTML, CSS, JavaScript or similar tools, and have contributed code that has shipped to production, for example front-end changes or design system components submitted through pull requests.Â Hands-on experience using AI coding and design tools, such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, to prototype faster and ship real work. We want someone who uses these tools well and can show how they have changed the way their team works.Â Working knowledge of accessibility and WCAG. You have designed to WCAG standards, tested for it, and built accessibility into your team's design system and review process.Â An interest in design systems and data-informed decision-making.Â You do not need to tick every box. We care about the quality of your thinking, the way you work with people and your ability to turn ambitious ideas into better product experiences.Â All Fuellies are a core part of our culture and making Fuel50 an amazing place to work. Some additional benefits are:Â Â A day off on your birthday and your Fuel50 anniversaryÂ A âReFuel Dayâ once a quarter to relax and refuelÂ Remote work and flexible work times - we're supportive of school commitments, traveling in off-peak hours, and attending to lifeâs eventsÂ A progressive parental leave policyÂ Comprehensive fully subsidised health insurance with Southern CrossÂ What's it like to be a Fuellie? Fuel50âs team is fully remote, with an HQ in New Zealand, and team members across five countries. We have a co-working space in the BHive in Takapuna that we use to meet occasionally for team and strategic planning and other team events. If youâre based outside of Auckland and are needed on-site for anything, weâll pay for you to get here.Â We know that having the right people with the right attitude and behaviour is a big part of what makes us successful.Â Living our values is an important part of being successful in this role.Â Â We have a culture around continuous and respectful feedback and recognition - be part of a team working towards a common goal and helping each other every step of the way.Â Â We have #SuperheroAwards at quarterly planning meetings and spontaneous recognition and shout-outs across the business.Â Â We'll have your back when you need help - your colleagues want to see you succeed and work hard to help you do so.Â Â We work hard and deliver amazing results to our clients - when you see our amazing feedback, you'll be proud to be a Fuellie.Â Application process: If this sounds like you, then please apply. If youâre not sure you're ready or perhaps you don't meet all requirements yet, please apply anyway. We'll review every application that we get.Â Â Please include a link to your portfolio or attach it as part of your application.Â This role is based in New Zealand, candidates must hold the relevant right to work in NZ i.e. Citizenship or a work visa at the time of application.Â Please mention the word **GLOWING** and tag RNjQuMjM2LjE0Mi4xMzM= when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RNjQuMjM2LjE0Mi4xMzM=). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

title: Inside Sales Contractor
description: About Us We are a financial services start up focusing on helping to improve consumer credit profiles. We are currently seeking KPI driven sales representatives looking to earn up to 45K in their first year while working remotely. We offer comprehensive training and continuous sales coaching to help you meet your financial goals. During our training period we offer a guaranteed training stipend while our trainees are acclimating to the position (*see weekly pay below). If you are a seasoned sales professional looking for the autonomy of a remote position combined with great compensation, we want to hear from you! Compensation Structure This role is 100% commission-based , which means your earning potential is unlimited. In addition, we regularly offer competitive performance-based bonuses to reward hard work and results. Weeks 2–4: Guaranteed training stipend of $500 USD total – or your commission if it’s higher. You’ll always receive whichever amount benefits you most. title: Data Director, Payments
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London or UK Remote | 💰 £150,000 - £200, 000 + Equity +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a> </p> <p><br><strong>About our Data Discipline </strong></p> <p>We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. Data is central to how we understand our customers, shape our products, manage risk and grow Monzo sustainably. We believe in empowering teams with high-quality, trusted data and self-serve analytics, while creating space for Data practitioners to focus on the highest-impact questions, opportunities and decisions.</p> <p>Our Data discipline is centralised, but deeply embedded in Monzo’s product areas. Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers and Analysts work in cross-functional squads alongside Engineers, Designers, Product Managers, Marketers and other specialists. This means Data is not a downstream service: we help shape strategy, challenge thinking, build the data foundations teams need to move quickly, and share accountability for customer and commercial outcomes.</p> <h2><strong>Our Payments team ⭐</strong></h2> <p>At Monzo, payments are more than just moving money from A to B. They are a core part of how customers experience trust, speed, and financial control every day. As a Data Director in Payments, you would help shape seamless local payment experiences, ensuring customers can pay and get paid reliably while continuing to modernise the infrastructure that powers millions of transactions behind the scenes.</p> <p>The role also sits at the intersection of Monzo’s broader ambition to build truly borderless banking and expand into new markets. That means designing products and payment capabilities that work effortlessly across geographies, currencies, and customer needs, while helping Monzo scale into new markets with the same simplicity and transparency that defines the brand today.</p> <p>You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Design to help shape Monzo’s payments strategy to make Monzo's global ambitions a reality, enabling revenue and customer growth with a resilient, self-serve banking platform. </p> <p>To succeed, you should be excited about solving tough, ambiguous business problems with analytical rigour, commercial viability and execution effectiveness<br><br></p> <p><strong>Your day-to-day </strong></p> <ul> <li>Establish yourself as a trusted member of the Payments Leadership team, enabling better decisions across Payments and the wider Data Discipline</li> <li>Co-drive Payments strategy and product decisions with Product and Engineering, bringing Data into discovery early to shape priorities and challenge thinking</li> <li>Identify untapped opportunities for commercial optimisation, including across pricing, commercialisation, investment and customer growth</li> <li>Set the data strategy for Payments, including the operating model, team priorities, architecture, technical debt and key metrics and drivers</li> <li>Translate between technical, product and commercial perspectives to help teams make clear, high-impact decisions</li> <li>Develop and scale a high-performing team of data professionals sharing accountability for product and business outcomes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <p>What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</p> <ul> <li>You have experience driving payments innovation and product strategy forward in a fast-growing business</li> <li>You combine deep Data expertise with strong product and commercial judgement. </li> <li>You can move comfortably from detailed metrics or architecture discussions to customer strategy, pricing and business outcomes</li> <li>You are an empathetic people leader who can build trust quickly, raise the performance bar and retain excellent talent</li> <li>You have experience growing and leading a full stack data team, including individual contributors and managers across Data Science, Analytics Engineering, Machine Learning Engineering and Analytics</li> <li>You have experience collaborating with senior cross-functional stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing and risk/control functions</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>The Interview Process</strong></p> <p>After an informal ~30 min recruiter call, our interview process involves 2 main stages. We promise not to ask you any brain teasers or trick questions!</p> <ol> <li><strong>Initial Call (1 hour)</strong> You'll meet with one of our senior data leaders.</li> <li><strong>Loop Stage</strong> - This is one stage with 4 interviews (totalling 4 hours) split between a collaboration with one of our engineers on a technical exercise, as well as behavioural and leadership interviews. You can have this all in one day or split these across multiple days, whichever your prefer.</li> </ol> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact us on tech-hiring@monzo.com</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>How we work 💻:</strong></p> <p><strong>Locations & Flexible Working : </strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. </p> <p>We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. </p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨</p> <p>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</p> <h3><strong>What’s in it for you</strong></h3> <p>💰Base salary £150, 000 - £200, 000 + Equity + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a> </p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK  </p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>#LI-AL1 #LI-REMOTE</p> <p><a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"><strong><br><br></strong></a></p> <p><br><br></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Talent Sourcer
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: We're looking to hire a new Talent Sourcer in Tokyo to build top-of-funnel talent pipelines and shape talent strategy across our Go-To-Market (GTM) organization. In this role, you'll partner with regional leadership to fill critical GTM roles like Solutions Consultants https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/notion/15dde0f5-b3fd-4d46-8ec2-0858ebdd888d and Outcomes Architects https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/notion/7030916f-4277-45db-9fed-644bb3fba059 primarily in Japan. WHAT YOU'LL DO: - You'll manage the sourcing process from inception through successful close, ensuring an exceptional experience for candidates and hiring managers at every step - You'll serve as a strategic advisor and talent sourcing expert, leading successful searches across GTM roles - You'll conduct initial qualification screenings and casual chats with candidates to assess fit and build relationships - You'll collaborate with the broader team on process improvements, programs, and strategic initiatives - You'll lead talent branding initiatives, including organizing hiring webinars and publishing blogs and articles that feature our employees - You'll provide talent mapping and market insights to support local and global recruiting and hiring teams - You'll make informed data-driven decisions that build efficiencies into the sourcing process - You'll find creative and unconventional ways to help us build a diverse top-of-funnel for GTM roles across all levels - You'll help build and manage partnerships to bring more underrepresented talent to Notion - You'll advance our Inclusion, Diversity, Equity, and Accessibility (I.D.E.A) strategy, working to build more diverse and inclusive teams WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Manage sourcing for multiple complex and evergreen searches, creating innovative strategies and engagement to bring the best and most diverse talent to Notion - Help develop and execute comprehensive sourcing plans, analyzing role requirements to define target profiles and identify qualified candidates - Partner closely with other members of the Recruiting team to ensure we hit our hiring targets without sacrificing quality - Collaborate closely with Hiring Managers throughout the recruiting process to ensure we meet their hiring needs and goals - Establish and maintain meaningful relationships with management and key cross-functional stakeholders SKILLS AND TOOLSET YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - At least 3 years of experience in talent sourcing or recruitment, whether in-house or agency, or relevant transferable skills from related fields - Experience using LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing tools, with skills in Boolean and AI-powered searches (or eagerness to learn these tools) - Persistence, consistency, and attention to detail - if we hire one person out of 200 candidates, you'd ensure the other 199 have a great experience. You care deeply about your craft. - Strong time management, prioritization, and organizational skills. You are self-motivated and committed to excellence - You are kind, warm, and thoughtful - you'll represent the company when you interact with thousands of candidates each year - You'll contribute across the full scope of recruiting operations, from maintaining our ATS database and finding new ways to source candidates to analyzing data to improve recruiting efficiency and managing sourcing channels - Fluency in Japanese and business-level English A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

title: Product Manager - Realtime
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. About the Role We're hiring a Product Manager for Supabase Realtime https://supabase.com/docs/guides/realtime. You'll own the surface area developers use to build live, collaborative and event-driven apps on Supabase: Broadcast https://supabase.com/docs/guides/realtime/broadcast, Presence https://supabase.com/docs/guides/realtime/presence, Postgres Changes https://supabase.com/docs/guides/realtime/postgres-changes, and the capabilities we build next. You'll work closely with the Realtime Engineering team and with partners across Product Management, Design and GTM. This role is ideal for someone who's excited about building tools for millions of developers and who has a passion for the types of user experiences unlocked by simple, scalable real-time channels. You should have a nuanced understanding of full-stack application development, including existing and emerging real-time and sync patterns. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - You'll collaborate with customers of all sizes and expertise levels: from an indie developer adding live updates to a side project, to startups building collaborative SaaS, to enterprise teams streaming live data to dashboards. - You'll own the problem statements and solution rationale behind the Realtime roadmap. This means working with Engineering and Design to shape how Supabase crafts the developer experience for the problems you’ve prioritized solving. - You'll shape how Realtime evolves to enable future application experiences, including its role in AI apps and alongside other Supabase products. - You'll own Realtime packaging and pricing, working with Pricing, Finance and Billing. - You'll use data to understand how Supabase developers are using Realtime features: where they succeed, where they get stuck, and what to tackle first. - You'll keep Engineering, Design and GTM aligned. You'll own the plan of record for what's coming, why, and in what order. YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU MUST HAVE - 5+ years of Product Management experience on developer tools, or are an ex-founder with equivalent depth. You're comfortable commenting on an architecture doc, following a design discussion, and advocating for the user when trade-offs are required. - Have owned an app development platform, feature or framework where real-time was core to the developer experience. - Get your own answers from data. You know what you care about in terms of product instrumentation and are comfortable querying and cleaning your own findings. - Are comfortable with Postgres and familiar with logical replication. - Work async by default. Supabase is fully remote. You make decisions in writing and move work forward without meetings. STRONG SIGNAL - You have an existing audience among developers, through social media, open source or developer advocacy. - Worked on a sync engine, local-first or live-query product. - Worked with gaming, AR or collaborative-tool customers. - Shipped something using Supabase. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

Over time, you’ll gain exposure to how we plan, execute, and scale hiring at Notion. With support from the team, you could take on light sourcing work, process improvements, and additional ownership as your skills grow - creating a strong foundation for future growth in recruiting, operations, or people-focused roles. title: Ubuntu Linux Kernel Engineer - Silicon Enablement
description: <p>Ubuntu Linux is already the most popular Linux distribution in the world, and its mission is to remain at the forefront of the global software ecosystem. As the industry evolves, we are expanding our support for a wider array of System on Chip (SoC) platforms to ensure that every user receives a high-performance and reliable experience. There is growing and vital demand from major silicon manufacturers such as NVIDIA, AMD, Qualcomm, MediaTek, and Renesas to provide Ubuntu Linux as the foundational platform for their next-generation hardware.</p> <p>The Canonical Kernel Team is responsible for the build, maintenance, and distribution of the Linux kernel for Ubuntu. We are looking for engineers who share our passion for building high-quality, robust software foundations that others can rely upon. This role sits at a critical junction in the software stack, ensuring that the underlying hardware is seamlessly integrated, optimized and prepared to meet the demands of modern computing.</p> <p>While direct experience with the Linux kernel would be an advantage, it is not a hard requirement. Candidates with RTOS or bare-metal experience and demonstrable hardware experience are encouraged to apply.</p> <p>We welcome applications from engineers at various stages of their careers, from those beginning their journey in hardware-level development to seasoned industry veterans.</p> <h2><strong>Location</strong></h2> <p>This is a globally remote role.</p> <h2><strong>What the role entails</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Drive the integration of platform support from our silicon partners into the Ubuntu Linux kernel</li> <li>Lead the identification and resolution of complex kernel issues reported by partners, customers, or discovered through rigorous testing</li> <li>Own the delivery of distinct, silicon-optimized variants of the Ubuntu Linux kernel to the global community</li> <li>Develop and refine the tooling and automation required for the reliable delivery and testing of our kernels</li> <li>Manage the submission and review process for upstream patches, collaborating effectively with both internal and external maintainers</li> <li>Identify new methodologies and strategies for maximizing performance on partner silicon</li> <li>Collaborate proactively within a globally distributed engineering team to ensure cohesive outcomes across the organization</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Proficiency in C programming, particularly for low-level system development</li> <li>A strong grasp of device drivers, BSPs, and other aspects of hardware-level system engineering</li> <li>Deep understanding of operating system kernel fundamentals</li> <li>Professional proficiency with Git for version control and collaborative development</li> <li>Ability to communicate effectively in English, both written and verbal, within a professional context</li> <li>A professional approach to collaborating with business partners and the open-source community</li> <li>Ability to travel twice a year for company events of up to two weeks in length</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience with Python or Bash scripting for automation and tooling</li> <li>Prior experience working with major SoC families (e.g., NVIDIA, Intel, AMD, Qualcomm, MediaTek, Renesas)</li> <li>Familiarity with Ubuntu, Debian, or Snap packaging</li> <li>Demonstrated expertise in Linux kernel patching and debugging</li> <li>A deep understanding of performance optimization techniques for silicon platforms</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we offer you</strong></h2> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Home-based work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About Canonical</strong></h2> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h2><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></h2> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. </p> <p><a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p> </p> <p>#LI-remote</p>

title: Data Director, EU
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍 London, Barcelona, or UK Remote | 💰 £150,900 to £204,100 + stock options & <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">benefits</a> | ✅ Visa sponsorship & relocation available</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>About our Data Discipline </strong></p> <p>We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. Data is central to how we understand our customers, shape our products, manage risk and grow Monzo sustainably. We believe in empowering teams with high-quality, trusted data and self-serve analytics, while creating space for Data practitioners to focus on the highest-impact questions, opportunities and decisions.</p> <p>Our Data Discipline is deeply embedded in Monzo’s product areas. Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, and Machine Learning Engineers work in cross-functional squads alongside Engineers, Designers, Product Managers and other disciplines. This means Data is not a downstream service, and instead we shape strategy, challenge thinking, build the data foundations teams need to move quickly, and share accountability for customer and commercial outcomes.</p> <p> </p> <h4><strong>Our EU team ⭐</strong></h4> <p>Our EU Data team is a full-stack Data team, and together we're building Monzo's presence across Europe from the ground up. We're entering new markets, learning what customers in each one need and finding product-market fit for Monzo. </p> <p> </p> <p>Our mission is to make money work for everyone, everywhere. As Data Director for EU expansion you'll lead the Data team and shape our product strategy as we grow, deciding where we place our bets, working out what to measure before there's a playbook, and making sure each new market learns fast enough to compound into the next.</p> <p> </p> <p>You'll work closely with EU leadership (our EU CEO, Country Managers and VP of Product) and Monzo's global Leadership team (the CTO, Head of Data and other Data Directors), sitting on the EU Tech Leadership team and helping shape our global data strategy. To do this well you'll need to relish ambiguity, bringing analytical rigour and commercial judgement to bets that often have to be made before the data is complete.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <p>You'll own the full learning loop that EU expansion runs on, and you'll co-own the product development loop alongside EU Leadership, Product and Engineering. In a new market that often means building those loops from scratch, so you're accountable not just for measuring what happens, but for framing the questions, defining what good looks like, and building the systems that answer them. You'll be a senior voice on the EU Tech Leadership team, the person who reframes the hard problems and puts a number on the trade-off between what's valuable for customers and what's valuable for the business.</p> <p><em>Shaping product and commercial strategy:</em></p> <ul> <li>You'll decide where Monzo should bet as we enter each new European market, sizing the opportunity and finding product-market fit for the products and segments most likely to win.</li> <li>You'll use sharp commercial judgement to work through the ambiguity of building in a new market, from pricing and positioning to the levers that drive growth, bringing Data into strategy early so we shape priorities rather than react to decisions already made.</li> </ul> <p><em>Owning the data strategy and the learning loops:</em></p> <ul> <li>You'll set the data strategy for EU and stand up the foundations each new market needs, from the events we log and the metrics and experiments we design to the forecasts markets learn from.</li> <li>Lead the goal-setting process for EU Expansion, bringing clarity to metric selection and target setting, in close partnership with Finance.</li> </ul> <p><em>Changing how decisions get made:</em></p> <ul> <li>You'll represent Data directly at the ExCo level, building a shared language of metrics and analytical reasoning so that Data drives EU strategy rather than reporting on it.</li> <li>You'll drive cross-collective collaboration, spotting the high-leverage connections across the business, for example how savings features drive engagement in our Wealth collective.</li> </ul> <p><em>Building and leading a high-performing team:</em></p> <ul> <li>You'll build, grow and retain a high-performing, full-stack Data team, where everyone shares accountability for product and business outcomes.</li> <li>You'll raise the performance bar, develop the next generation of Data leaders, and model an inclusive, high-craft Data culture as we scale.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <p>What we're doing here at Monzo excites you, and the idea of helping take it across Europe especially so!</p> <ul> <li>You're a strategic data leader who has operated at Director level or above, and you're energised by zero-to-one ambiguity, having built or scaled a data function in a new market, product line or business from an early stage.</li> <li>You move comfortably from detailed metrics and data architecture to customer strategy, commercial outcomes and product-market fit, and you're happy to be the opinionated voice in the room that reframes the trade-off.</li> <li>You lead through learning loops and hold a high technical bar, because you've built or owned the measurement a business relies on to set goals, run experiments and improve, with the judgement to know which methods and investments will pay off.</li> <li>You have experience leading company-wide or division-wide goal-setting, defining high-clarity metrics, setting targets and partnering closely with Finance.</li> <li>You change how organisations make decisions, not just how one project turns out, and you have experience of the cross-collective collaboration that connects the dots across different business areas.</li> <li>You're an empathetic people leader who has grown full-stack Data teams of both individual contributors and managers, comfortable representing Data at ExCo and to C-level peers, and you know what it takes to attract, develop and retain top talent.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>30 minute recruiter call</li> <li>45 minute call with the hiring manager</li> <li>4 x 1-hour video calls with various team members, including the General Manager for Payments</li> <li>A meet and greet with a member of EU Executive Committee</li> </ol> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £150,900 to £204,100 + stock options and<a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits"> benefits </a></p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London or Barcelona office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team</p> <p>📚 Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p> </p> <p>#LI-JH1  #LI-Remote</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Product Manager - Auth
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE We're hiring a Product Manager for Supabase Auth https://supabase.com/docs/guides/auth. You'll own the surface area that developers use to authenticate and authorize their end users and manage identity in their apps: email, phone and social login, passkeys and MFA https://supabase.com/docs/guides/auth/auth-mfa, enterprise SSO, the OAuth 2.1 server https://supabase.com/docs/guides/auth/oauth-server, auth hooks, and support for organizations and multi-tenant applications. You'll work closely with the Auth engineering team and with partners across Product Management, Security, Design and GTM. This role is ideal for someone who’s excited about building tools for millions of developers and who has a strong understanding of existing and emerging authentication practices and protocols. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - You'll collaborate with customers of all sizes and expertise levels. Indie developers shipping a side project, startups choosing their first auth stack, SaaS teams designing multi-tenant access, and enterprises in security review. - You'll own the problem statements and solution rationale behind the Auth roadmap. This means working with Engineering and Design to shape how Supabase crafts the developer experience for the problems you’ve prioritized solving. - You'll define how Auth works for AI agents on Supabase: agents that sign users up, act on their behalf, and call APIs. - You'll use data to understand how Supabase developers are using Auth features: where they succeed, where they get stuck, and what to tackle first. - You'll keep Engineering, Design and GTM aligned. You'll own the plan of record for what's coming, why, and in what order. YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU MUST HAVE - 5+ years of Product Management experience on developer tools, or are an ex-founder with equivalent depth. You're comfortable commenting on an architecture doc, following a design discussion, and advocating for the user when trade-offs are required. - Have shipped standards-based auth or identity products. You've owned OAuth/OIDC, SAML, SCIM, sessions or token design, and you know from experience where each one breaks for customers. - Work comfortably with corporate buyers and with developers. You can work through a CISO's security review and an indie developer's bug report in the same week. You have intuition on which enterprise asks are real value-adding requirements and which are checkbox items. - Are comfortable with Postgres and familiar with row-level security. - Work async by default. Supabase is fully remote. You make decisions in writing and move work forward without meetings. STRONG SIGNAL - Owned auth or identity inside an integrated cloud platform. - Ran an organizations, tenancy, or SSO+SCIM launch from start to finish. - Designed auth for agents or other automated systems: OAuth for MCP clients, machine-to-machine credentials, scoped tokens. - Shipped something using Supabase. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
description: Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating. We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you. Duties · Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients · Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success · Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required · Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services. · Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines · Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues · Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management · Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment · Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices · Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives Our Technology Stack · Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA · Documentation – Hudu · RMM – Intune / Immybot · Networking – Meraki · Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365 · Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon · Door Access – Avigilon Qualification · 6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support · Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry · Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service · Proven experience leading IT projects · A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications · Background in providing direct end-user support · High level of attention to detail · Excellent verbal and written communication skills · IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent) · Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents Our Core Values Dream Big, Then Make
